author: Kerry Danelle McAulay
text: I don’t do any martial arts but skin barrier ie cavilon,skin tac,skin prep and a cover over it you should be fine u can use a tube grip bandage too to hold it in place im clumsy banging into door frames and table tops 🤦🏼‍♀️🤣 and it’s saved a few sensors

author: Bradley Moore-Starling
text: SkinTac is going to be your best friend. Also use the covers that have a hard shell over the sensor then a cover over that, you should be good to go.

author: Shirl Mulcahy
text: I used the hard shell with the plaster over the top, saves it being knocked off at work
